title: Each member row has a bare "Remove" link that removes the number in one click, with no confirm
what_happens: Every member row shows a top-level "Remove" text button next to the language. One click sends the DELETE at once; there is no "…" menu and no confirmation.
who_hurts: An admin scanning or clicking near a row can drop a real participant from the list by accident, and they will silently miss the next invite sent to that list.
suggested_fix: Move Remove into a per-row "…" menu and ask before it runs (the same two-step pattern EditListForm already uses for Delete list). src/app/admin/lists/[id]/remove-member-button.tsx, used at src/app/admin/lists/[id]/page.tsx:83.
rule: Dane's UI rule: "Never put a Delete button (or any other destructive action: remove, archive, cancel, void) at the top level of a row, card or page header. It always goes inside a \"…\" actions menu, with a confirmation before it runs."
